title: מעלה מכמש (Ma'ale Mikhmash)
author: S. Riklin
location_note: Fort north of Ma'ale Mikhmash on the desert fringe, by the road from Bethel and 'Ai toward the desert plateau west of Jericho.
notes: Four-room building of the second half of the 7th c. BCE to the end of the kingdom of Judah. Features around the fort only surveyed.

features.subtype: cupmarks cut in rock surfaces near the fort
three caves with collapsed roofs near the fort
cistern near the fort

title: ירושלים, החומה השלישית (Jerusalem, The Third Wall)
author: R. Abu Riya
location_note: (A) petrol station on Nablus Rd. at 'Amr ibn el-'As St.; (B) areas Ea-Ef along the Third Wall, near the St. Etienne monastery.
notes: Byzantine monastery room; Third Wall foundations with a coin of Agrippa I and Herodian marginal dressing; tunnel and sewage channel of the late Ottoman period (Ea1).

features.subtype: plastered slab-covered drainage channel A built into wall W1, and later channel B; part of a wider system of channels and cisterns
features.period: Byzantine (coins of the 4th-8th c. CE in channel A; also 1st c. CE sherds)

features.subtype: quarried rock mass under the room, 2 m below the floor
features.period: Roman (sherds of the 1st c. CE and Late Roman on the rock)
features.quote: החדר הוקם על גבי מחצבה מן התקופה .הרומית

features.subtype: part of a rock-cut plastered cistern cut by a wall with Roman sherds
features.period: earlier than a wall with Roman sherds

features.subtype: two white-plastered channels leading to a cistern 3 m to the west
features.quote: התעלות הטוחות בטיח ,לבן מוליכות אל בור ,מים

features.subtype: upper part of a tomb with a plastered ashlar vault (excavated by the Jordanian Department of Antiquities in 1966)
features.quote: חלקו העליון של ,קבר שתקרתו בנויה כקמרון

features.subtype: water pool partly exposed, cleared to 2.6 m
rock-cut and built hydraulic-plastered pool, probably roofed (piers), with an adjacent plastered installation; fill with a coin of Herod
features.period: construction not dated; out of use by the 6th-7th c. CE
features.quote: נחשף הקטע המזרחי של בריכת מים

features.subtype: oval plastered cistern with slab cover, feed pipe and settling pit, perhaps reusing an earlier shaft tomb
features.period: Late Byzantine, Umayyad and medieval pottery (with the monastery)

title: ירושלים, שער הרחמים (Jerusalem, Golden Gate)
author: R. Reich, E. Shukron
notes: Second Temple houses and stone-vessel and opus sectile workshops below 10 m of debris. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, קשת רובינסון (Jerusalem, Robinson's Arch)
author: R. Reich, Y. Billig
location_note: Western Wall street and Robinson's Arch pier; no map reference.
notes: Herodian street paved in the 1st c. CE (probably under Agrippa II) with shops; 70 CE collapse; Latin milestone of Vespasian and Titus; Umayyad building IV.
extra_quotes: העפר שנמצא בה כלל שברי כלי חרס מן המאה הא׳ לפסה״נ

features.subtype: stepped plastered miqveh west of the western row of shops
features.quote: ממערב לטור החנויות נחשף מקווה טהרה מדורג ,ומטויח

features.subtype: hoard of more than 200 bronze coins (mostly First Revolt prutot, latest Year 4) probably hidden in a shop wall
features.quote: כן נתגלה ,מטמון הכולל למעלה ממאתים מטבעות ברונזה

features.subtype: upper drainage system built directly under the street paving, with grated gutters
features.quote: מערכת התעלות ,העליונה הבנויה הישר מתחת לריצוף

features.subtype: lower large drain, mostly rock-cut and stone-vaulted (1 m wide, 4 m deep), cleared between Warren's shafts
features.period: fill with 1st c. BCE pottery only
features.quote: חצובה התעלה בסלע והיא מקורה בקמרון אבן

features.subtype: small water pool put out of use by the Umayyad pier foundations
features.quote: טור האומנות נבנה אל תוך בריכת מים קטנה

features.subtype: two drainage channels crossing the Roman-Byzantine wall 523 and a slab-covered channel along the arch pier over the Herodian paving
features.period: Roman-Byzantine (after 70 CE), reused in the Umayyad drainage

title: ירושלים, חקל דמא (Jerusalem, Akeldama)
author: B. Zissu
location_note: 37 m west of the St. Onuphrius monastery, lower Hinnom valley.

features.subtype: burial cave with carved facade and frame, chamber with six kokhim and an arcosolium with two more; three ossuaries, chalk measuring cup
second robbed burial cave 30 m south-west with arched frame

title: ירושלים, עיר דוד (Jerusalem, City of David)
author: R. Reich, E. Shukron
location_note: Eastern slope of the City of David and the Shiloah road in the Kidron; no map reference.
notes: Wall 10 and houses of the late Iron II.

features.subtype: complete cooking pots placed in two layers against wall 10, containing animal and fish bones, covered with bowls (excavators: sacred food or priestly gifts)
features.period: Second Temple period, mainly late 2nd and 1st c. BCE
features.quote: נמצאו סירי בישול ,תמימים שזמנם ימי הבית ,השני

features.subtype: rock-cut slab-covered water channel plastered with yellow clay (locus 25)
rock-cut tunnel, part of 'Channel II' (Siloam channel), cleared for c. 30 m

title: ירושלים, כנסיית סט׳ פטרוס אין גליקנטו (Jerusalem, St. Peter in Gallicantu)
author: F. Diez
location_note: Mount Zion, Area B; no map reference.
notes: Herodian, Late Byzantine and Umayyad layers; inscribed half-shekel ('hsy') stone weight.

features.subtype: cistern with an ashlar vault, destroyed when wall a was built; nothing earlier than Herod found
features.period: not dated (no remains earlier than Herod in the area)

features.subtype: small rock-cut cistern (no. 2), earlier than the walls of squares VI and VIII; cistern 1 mentioned
small water channel between walls, later than the Byzantine-Umayyad floors
empty shaft tombs and a tomb with two bowls and a bronze dagger
features.period: Middle Bronze I and Middle Bronze IIA
features.quote: נתגלו כמה קברי פיר ריקים מתקופת הב״ת

features.subtype: caves with square openings; cave C2 with five round pits and an elongated pit (ash, donkey teeth, grinding stones) and a Persian floor with pottery

title: ירושלים, בית צפאפא (מערב) (Jerusalem, Beit Safafa, west)
author: B. Zissu, H. Moyal
notes: CLAIM (excavators): the shaft-grave type resembles graves at Kh. Qumran and Dead Sea shore sites and may be linked to the Essenes.
extra_quotes: של סירי בישול מן המאות הא׳-הב׳ לפסה״נ

features.subtype: cemetery of 49 dense shaft graves (41 excavated), single primary burials, one plain ossuary
features.period: hewn at the end of the Second Temple period, used until the Bar Kokhba revolt; two reused in the Byzantine period
features.quote: יש לתארך את חציבת הקברים לשלהי ימי הבית ,השני

features.subtype: two robbed kokhim burial caves 30 m south
features.period: type common in Second Temple Jerusalem and Judea (no datable finds)
features.quote: שתי מערות קבורה מן הטיפוס הנפוץ בירושלים וביהודה

features.subtype: rock-cut pit (c. 4.5 x 7.5 m) with square shaft used for burial, sealed with slabs in antiquity
features.period: cooking pots of the 2nd-1st c. BCE
features.quote: נפגע בעת סלילת הכביש בור ,חצוב אשר שימש .לקבורה

features.subtype: miqveh 300 m south-west of the cemetery (surveyed by D. Amit)
features.quote: נסקרו על ידי ד׳ עמית מקווה טהרה

features.subtype: columbarium installation 300 m south-west of the cemetery (surveyed by D. Amit)

title: ח׳ בית בצה (Kh. Beit Bassa)
author: Y. Barukh, A. Sharukh (second name partly unreadable in the copy)
location_note: Hill c. 1.5 km south-east of Bethlehem.
notes: CLAIM (excavators): identification with Beth-basi of 1 Macc. 9:60-73.

features.subtype: robbed burial cave with forecourt, standing pit and benches; fragments of a small decorated ossuary
rock-cut miqveh 20 m west of the cave: forecourt with three steps, two arched openings to a grey-plastered immersion chamber

title: כפר קליל (Kafr Qallil)
author: O. Sion, A. el-Rahim
location_note: Outskirts of Kafr Qallil, c. 3 km south of Shechem (Nablus).

features.subtype: robbed burial cave: chamber with three kokhim in the west wall and one in the east, a fifth begun
features.period: few Roman and Byzantine sherds (not subdivided)

title: ירושלים, רח׳ שמואל הנביא (Jerusalem, Shemuel Ha-Navi St.)
author: R. Abu Riya

features.subtype: burial cave: square chamber with one kokh, pile of stones with skulls and bones
features.period: plan typical of the Second Temple period in the Jerusalem area
features.quote: תוכנית המערה אופיינית לימי הבית השני באזור

features.subtype: robbed burial cave with standing pit and three kokhim, long left open
features.period: not dated (mixed Byzantine to modern pottery in the fill)

title: ירושלים, מזרח תלפיות (Jerusalem, East Talpiyot; archive report, permit 1446)
author: O. Hess
location_note: No map reference in the entry; zone from the name (Jerusalem, East Talpiyot).
notes: One-line entry in the list of excavation reports deposited in the IAA archive (screen heading HA106-173-2, pp. 173-175): no archaeological finds. No feature of the eligible classes.
